status: 3.4 NGV adaptation specification; current locked contracts preserved; baseline consumer issues are closed
order: Explicit current user instruction within the authorized task
Locked NGV host/pack contracts; unresolved contradictions require an explicit decision before implementation
Approved project canon within its phase and lineage
Source always-rules plus explicitly scoped source exceptions
Model/platform/scenario-specific reference rule and original evidence confidence

overrides.sourceBehavior: Source W1/W10 and intake ordering
overrides.ngvApplication: The active pack owns phase order. Musicvideo remains Track → optional Lyrics → Init → approved Analysis → optional existing material → story. Use W10 knowledge inside the relevant existing phases; a replacement phase graph requires an explicit decision.

overrides.sourceBehavior: One production bible as source truth
overrides.ngvApplication: Map bible roles to NGV canonical writers/artifacts and cumulative exact-byte lineage. Do not create an independent markdown authority. Draft/proposal and approval remain different states; phase edits require explicit rewind.

overrides.sourceBehavior: Story comes from user; missing story intake
overrides.ngvApplication: Musicvideo may be greenfield: propose story or nonnarrative concept from approved audio analysis and optional lyrics. Missing existing story files never block development. Execution prompts cannot silently invent unapproved beats.

overrides.sourceBehavior: Conversation follows user language; supplied prompt stays verbatim
overrides.ngvApplication: App interaction follows explicit app localization or an explicit language request. Generated model prompts remain English with literal dialogue in the declared dialogue language. Preserve user-supplied text as input/provenance; the normal route still precompiles it, never bypasses the prompt engine.

overrides.sourceBehavior: Skill excludes live-action and real-footage editing
overrides.ngvApplication: Reusable craft, coverage, structure, review and finishing also apply to imported/live_action/ai_enhanced shots. Generation-only anchors, paid routes and draft renders are conditional on source mode. Retain zero-generation musicvideo/film workflows.

overrides.sourceBehavior: Source prefers reference anchor and native video extension
overrides.ngvApplication: Current locked NGV contract supports explicit frame continuation OR verified native video extension. Frame continuation binds the exact predecessor last frame; native extension binds exact approved predecessor video plus executable mode. Never combine mechanisms or substitute a reference image. Source clean-boundary trimming requires a new immutable derived source and exact timestamp/frame lineage.

overrides.sourceBehavior: Source green labels, model versions, UI controls and capacities
overrides.ngvApplication: These are dated source claims, not live verified capabilities. Keep original date/confidence/route. Executability comes from enabled providers intersected with actual route support. Never transplant a UI field into an API or enable a provider from this corpus.

overrides.sourceBehavior: Default batches of four and 10–15 iterations
overrides.ngvApplication: 3.4 counts one batch of four as an iteration; three or four failures on the same axis fail it, one or two odd rolls do not. One failed run permits one steer/first exclusion; two justify the scoped restatement. Preserve remove → change → add, non-growing repair word count, protected successful lines and clean rewrite/channel change after three failed iterations. Paid batches, tests and 10-of-10 lead stress tests require existing budget authorization; no automatic spend.

overrides.sourceBehavior: Recipe Verify lines described as binary reroll gates
overrides.ngvApplication: Preserve source [edit] tags as assembly-only criteria: they never trigger a generation reroll. Other Verify clauses require frame/clip evidence under their actual applicability; status remains not_observed without it. Selected style controls compile according to project technique A/B/C only where deliberately steered.

overrides.sourceBehavior: Diegetic-only generation, no generated music; musical examples
overrides.ngvApplication: Musicvideo master audio is the original track. Referenced segments can drive performance/lip sync without becoming replacement soundtrack. Singing, spoken dialogue, VO, ambience and score are separate roles with explicit mouth ownership; keep scope of music-bleed exception.

overrides.sourceBehavior: Source AI interviews author soundbites before generation
overrides.ngvApplication: For actual documentary, paper edit selects attributed, consented source transcript ranges; no invented witness quote or synthetic footage passed off as evidence. Authored or reenacted interviews are a separately declared synthetic mode, preserving source/disclosure provenance.

overrides.sourceBehavior: New knowledge entities and metadata fields
overrides.ngvApplication: Use versioned resources/new extension artifacts under existing registration and loader. Do not add stored fields to compatible public V1 value types. Existing projects retain pinned pack/profile/library versions; migration is explicit and transactional.

overrides.sourceBehavior: UGC/handheld/elliptical styles tolerate artifacts
overrides.ngvApplication: A deliberate style may accept a named aesthetic imperfection; it does not excuse wrong identity, anatomy, unapproved canon changes or provenance gaps. Distinguish intentional camera following from accidental floating camera.

overrides.sourceBehavior: Worked examples and templates contain invented project names and parameters
overrides.ngvApplication: Keep example and template content available in full, but instantiate only from actual project data and verified route. Never promote example light/weather/plot, prices, IDs or account names into canon.

overrides.sourceBehavior: Source legal/licensing statements
overrides.ngvApplication: Preserve attribution, consent, rights and disclosure procedures and the source date. Do not compile jurisdiction-specific legal conclusions into an automatic green gate. No additional legal research or advice is asserted by this extraction.

overrides.sourceBehavior: Complete knowledge vs selective context
overrides.ngvApplication: Conserve the full archive, but select task/phase/technique sections or required units. Do not load large source files wholesale or a second technique chapter. Shared 12h Lint paragraph is available to B/C without loading A; source registry is loaded when evidence is disputed. Context traces prove actual retrieval.

overrides.sourceBehavior: Footage-authenticity timecode/REC tells and recipe chapter cards vs source red-list readable-text ban
overrides.ngvApplication: Exact text goes to post by default. Preserve 3.4 renderability section 2 documented exceptions separately: master-plate-locked short text, official H3 quoted-text channel and a dedicated template/motion-design route. Each needs actual route support and observed text stability; no blanket ban and no blanket reliability claim.

overrides.sourceBehavior: Rule 4 technique menu A/B/C with no universal default
overrides.ngvApplication: Choose and persist one technique per project with the director at the applicable creative intake after approved music analysis; no additional pre-analysis step. Unanswered choices remain explicitly ASSUMED with the menu and rationale. One-off W3 assumed A is a scoped exception, not a global default. Technique changes require an explicit versioned decision and downstream invalidation.

overrides.sourceBehavior: Model owns composition/cutting/body mechanics/material/light behaviour by default
overrides.ngvApplication: Agent retains canon, scene/beat/end states, reference jobs and required continuity. Only explicit canon, deliberate look or a failed batch on this take licenses a control on a model-owned axis. Record reason and source in Crew choices; do not serialize all populated IR fields unconditionally. Deterministic source provenance and canonical approval gates still apply.

overrides.sourceBehavior: New agent-models cold-test table and delegation advice
overrides.ngvApplication: Store named model/harness/skill versions, sample count and unmeasured cells as historical evidence, not a current ranking or success rate. Adapt fixtures to local NGV context. Never infer permission for agent delegation, model switching, spending, approvals or PROPOSAL picks from this source.
